reason: A media utility plugin that analyzes video or audio URLs and downloads media streams from supported sites to local files.

summaries.zh: 用于分析视频或音频链接并将支持站点的媒体流下载到本地文件。
summaries.en: Analyzes video or audio URLs and downloads media streams from supported sites to local files.

capabilities: Analyzes media URLs and identifies likely site, quality, container, and MIME hints
Fetches media URLs over the network with redirects and configurable request headers
Streams downloaded media content to a local file path
Parses quality and file extensions without network access
